question: How does kuṇḍalinī act upon the seed and where is she situated?
premises: Kuṇḍalinī is named as the agent who presses the seed.
Her action is described as occurring by division of essence and fragment.
She is located in the bulb and moves in all directions as guide of the inhabited seat.
inference: Kuṇḍalinī, situated in the bulb and guiding the inhabited seat, presses the seed by dividing essence and fragment and moves on all sides.
uncertainties: The technical meanings of rasa and śalka in this ritual context are not fully determined by the verse alone.
plain_english: Here Kuṇḍalinī presses the seed by dividing essence and fragment; situated in the bulb and guiding the inhabited seat, she moves on all sides.
